note: Slice of a recorded PRD (api layer) and its measured reach; used to test the endpoint round matching against real data.

apiEndpoints.summary: List the authenticated user's links; supports limit (max 50), skip, search query params; with Accept: text/html renders the links table partial instead.

responses.description: JSON { total, limit, skip, data: [links] } for the authenticated user

apiEndpoints.summary: Admin: list all links with filters banned, anonymous, has_domain, domain, user, search.

Create a short link. Body: target (required), optional customurl, password, description, expire_in, reuse, domain; customurl/password/domain/reuse require login; anonymous access only when DISALLOW_ANONYMOUS_LINKS is false.

responses.description: Validation errors, e.g. target missing, custom URL in use
Existing link returned when reuse=true matched

apiEndpoints.summary: Edit own link's address, target, description, expire_in, password (id is the 36-char uuid). Empty body field clears password if set.

responses.description: Invalid id or 'Should at least update one field.'

apiEndpoints.summary: Admin: edit any link with the same fields as user edit.
Delete own link (admins can technically delete any link via the same handler).
Admin: ban a link; optional body flags domain, host, user, userLinks cascade bans.

responses.description: Link not found or already banned; 'Couldn't fetch DNS info.' for host ban

apiEndpoints.summary: Visit statistics for a link (owner or admin).

responses.description: Stats object plus sanitized link fields

apiEndpoints.summary: Unlock a password-protected link with body { password }; returns the target URL.

responses.description: 'Couldn't find the link.' or invalid password/id

apiEndpoints.summary: Report abuse for a link on the default domain; disabled when MAIL_ENABLED is off.

body.link: short link URL on the default domain

responses.description: 'Thanks for the report, we'll take actions shortly.'
Feature disabled or link not on default domain

apiEndpoints.summary: Log in with email and password; returns a JWT (also set as token cookie for HTML requests). Disabled if DISALLOW_LOGIN_FORM.

responses.description: Unverified user when strict auth applies

apiEndpoints.summary: Sign up; requires MAIL_ENABLED and !DISALLOW_REGISTRATION, both currently disabled. Sends verification email.

responses.description: 'A verification email has been sent.' (untestable: mail disabled)
'Request is not allowed.' when registration or mail is disabled; validation errors; 'You can't use this email address.'

apiEndpoints.summary: Create the first admin user; only works when no user exists.

responses.description: 'Can not create the admin user because a user already exists.'

apiEndpoints.summary: Change own password; body: currentpassword, newpassword (each 8-64 chars).
Request email change; requires MAIL_ENABLED (currently disabled).

responses.description: 'Request is not allowed.' because MAIL_ENABLED is off

apiEndpoints.summary: Generate (replace) the account's API key.
Request password reset email; requires MAIL_ENABLED (currently disabled).

responses.description: 'Request is not allowed.' because MAIL_ENABLED is off

apiEndpoints.summary: Set a new password with reset_password_token (token present in body); token must be valid and unexpired.

responses.description: Success page (HTML-rendering handler; always renders partial)
'Could not set the password. Please try again later.'; 'Passwords don't match.'

apiEndpoints.summary: Current user's profile: apikey, email and owned domains.
Admin: list users with filters role, verified, banned, search, domains, links counts.
Admin: create a user with email, password (8-64), optional role (user|admin), verified, banned, verification_email flags.
Delete own account; requires correct password in body.
Admin: delete a user by numeric id.
Admin: ban a user; optional body flags links and domains cascade bans.

responses.description: 'No user has been found.' or 'User has been banned already.'

apiEndpoints.summary: Admin: list all domains with filters banned, owner, links, user, search.
Register a custom domain for own account; body: address (3-64 chars), optional homepage URL. Cannot be default domain, owned or banned domain.

responses.description: 'Domain is not valid.', 'You can't use the default domain.', 'You can't add this domain.'

apiEndpoints.summary: Admin: add any domain; body: address, optional homepage and banned flag.
Release own custom domain (unassigns user_id; does not remove links).

responses.description: 'Could not delete the domain.' for another user's domain

apiEndpoints.summary: Admin: permanently remove a domain; query links=true also removes its links.
Admin: ban a domain; optional body flags user and links cascade bans.

responses.description: 'No domain has been found.' or 'Domain has been banned already.'

apiEndpoints.summary: Health check returning plain 'OK'.

requirements.statement: An authenticated user can create a short link by POSTing a target URL to /api/v2/links.

acceptanceCriteria.text: POST /api/v2/links with body { target: 'https://example.com' } and a valid token returns 201 with id, address and link (short URL) in the response
Response password field is a boolean and user_id, banned_by_id, uuid are absent

requirements.statement: Creating a link with missing or invalid fields returns a 400 error with a field message.

acceptanceCriteria.text: POST /api/v2/links without target returns 400 with error 'Target is missing.'
POST /api/v2/links with an invalid target returns 400 with error 'URL is not valid.'
POST /api/v2/links with expire_in 'x' returns 400 with error 'Expire format is invalid. Valid examples: 1m, 8h, 42 days.'
POST /api/v2/links with expire_in '30s' returns 400 with error 'Expire time should be more than 1 minute.'

requirements.statement: Anonymous link creation is rejected when DISALLOW_ANONYMOUS_LINKS is enabled (default), and reserved addresses cannot be taken as custom URLs.

acceptanceCriteria.text: POST /api/v2/links without a token or API key returns 401 with error 'Unauthorized.'
A custom address matching a reserved path is rejected with 400 'You can't use this custom URL.'

requirements.statement: An authenticated user creating a link with a custom address already in use gets an error.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Creating a link twice with the same customurl returns 400 with error 'Custom URL is already in use.'

requirements.statement: Visiting a created short address redirects to its target.

acceptanceCriteria.text: GET /<short address> for a created link returns a redirect to the target URL

requirements.statement: Visiting a short address with a trailing '+' returns the link's target information instead of redirecting.

acceptanceCriteria.text: GET /<address>+ returns JSON { target }
With Accept: text/html it renders the URL info page showing the target

requirements.statement: A password-protected link shows a password page and can be unlocked with the correct credential.

acceptanceCriteria.text: GET /<address> for a password-protected link renders the protected password page (200 HTML, no redirect) unless a correct Basic auth password is given
With header Authorization: Basic base64(:correctpassword) the request redirects to the target

requirements.statement: Unlocking a protected link with the wrong password returns 401; with the correct password the target is returned.

acceptanceCriteria.text: POST /api/v2/links/{id}/protected with a wrong password returns 401 with error 'Password is not correct.'
POST /api/v2/links/{id}/protected with the correct password returns 200 with { target }

requirements.statement: A banned link redirects visitors to the /banned page.

acceptanceCriteria.text: GET /<address> for a banned link redirects to /banned
GET /banned renders the banned page with 200

requirements.statement: An unknown short address redirects to the /404 page.

acceptanceCriteria.text: GET /doesnotexist redirects to /404
GET /404 returns 404 status

requirements.statement: An authenticated user can list their own links with limit, skip and search query parameters.

acceptanceCriteria.text: GET /api/v2/links?limit=5&search=x returns 200 JSON with total, limit, skip and data array of sanitized links
A limit above 50 is capped at 50 in results

requirements.statement: A user can edit their own link's address, target, description, expiry and password.

acceptanceCriteria.text: PATCH /api/v2/links/{id} with a new target returns 200 with the updated link; a link owned by another user returns 400 'Link was not found.'
PATCH with no changed field returns 400 'Should at least update one field.'
PATCH with an address already in use returns 400 'Custom URL is already in use.'

requirements.statement: A user can delete their own link by its UUID.

acceptanceCriteria.text: DELETE /api/v2/links/{uuid} for own link returns 200 'Link has been deleted successfully.' and the link no longer resolves
DELETE for a link not owned by the caller fails with an error unless the caller is admin

requirements.statement: Only admins can list all links via /api/v2/links/admin; non-admins receive 401.

acceptanceCriteria.text: GET /api/v2/links/admin without admin role returns 401 'Unauthorized'
GET /api/v2/links/admin as admin returns 200 with all links including other users'

requirements.statement: An admin can ban a link, optionally banning its domain, host, owner and owner's links.

acceptanceCriteria.text: POST /api/v2/links/admin/ban/{uuid} as admin returns 200 'Banned link successfully.' and the link then redirects to /banned
Banning an already banned link returns 400 'Link has been banned already.'
Non-admin calling the ban endpoint returns 401

requirements.statement: A user can view visit statistics of their own link; other users' links are not accessible.

acceptanceCriteria.text: GET /api/v2/links/{uuid}/stats for own link returns 200 with a stats object including the link's visit data
Requesting stats for another user's link as non-admin returns 400 'Link could not be found.'

requirements.statement: A user can log in with email and password and receives a JWT token.

acceptanceCriteria.text: POST /api/v2/auth/login with valid credentials returns 200 { token }
POST /api/v2/auth/login with wrong password returns 401 'Login credentials are wrong.'

requirements.statement: The first admin account can be created only when no user exists yet.

acceptanceCriteria.text: POST /api/v2/auth/create-admin with valid email and password on an empty instance returns 201 { token }
POST /api/v2/auth/create-admin when any user exists returns 400 'Can not create the admin user because a user already exists.'

requirements.statement: A logged-in user can change their password with the current password.

acceptanceCriteria.text: POST /api/v2/auth/change-password with wrong currentpassword returns 401 'Current password is not correct.'
With correct current password returns 200 'Your password has been changed successfully.' and the new password then works for login

requirements.statement: A logged-in user can generate a new API key which replaces the previous one.

acceptanceCriteria.text: POST /api/v2/auth/apikey returns 201 { apikey }
Generating a new key replaces the stored key so the old key no longer authenticates

requirements.statement: Signup, email change and password reset requests are rejected while email is disabled.

acceptanceCriteria.text: POST /api/v2/auth/signup returns 400 'Request is not allowed.' because MAIL_ENABLED is off
POST /api/v2/auth/change-email and /api/v2/auth/reset-password return the same 400 'Request is not allowed.'

requirements.statement: A logged-in user can fetch their own profile (apikey, email and owned domains).

acceptanceCriteria.text: GET /api/v2/users with a valid token returns 200 { apikey, email, domains }

requirements.statement: A user can delete their own account by confirming their password.

acceptanceCriteria.text: POST /api/v2/users/delete with a wrong password returns 400 'Password is not correct.'
POST /api/v2/users/delete with the correct password returns 200 and removes the account (the account can no longer log in)

requirements.statement: An admin can create a new user directly, without email verification.

acceptanceCriteria.text: POST /api/v2/users/admin as admin with email/password creates the user and returns 201 'The user has been created successfully.'
Creating a user with an already used email returns 400 'User already exists.'
Passwords shorter than 8 characters are rejected with 400

requirements.statement: Only admins can list all users via /api/v2/users/admin, with role, verified and banned filters.

acceptanceCriteria.text: GET /api/v2/users/admin as non-admin returns 401
GET /api/v2/users/admin as admin returns 200 with total, limit, skip and data of users

requirements.statement: An admin can ban a user, optionally banning their links and domains; a banned user cannot log in.

acceptanceCriteria.text: POST /api/v2/users/admin/ban/{id} as admin returns 200 'Banned user successfully.' and the banned user can no longer log in (403 'You're banned from using this website.')
Banning an already banned user returns 400 'User has been banned already.'

requirements.statement: An admin can delete a user by numeric id.

acceptanceCriteria.text: DELETE /api/v2/users/admin/{id} as admin returns 200 'User has been deleted successfully.'
Deleting a nonexistent user id returns 400 'Could not find the user.'

requirements.statement: A user can register a custom domain for their account.

acceptanceCriteria.text: POST /api/v2/domains as user with a valid address returns the sanitized domain object with id and homepage
Adding the default domain returns 400 'You can't use the default domain.'
Adding a domain already owned or banned returns 400 'You can't add this domain.'

requirements.statement: A user can release their own custom domain; other users' domains cannot be released.

acceptanceCriteria.text: DELETE /api/v2/domains/{uuid} for own domain returns 200 'Domain deleted successfully'
Trying to release another user's domain returns 400 'Could not delete the domain.'

requirements.statement: An admin can add any domain and delete or ban domains via the admin endpoints.

acceptanceCriteria.text: POST /api/v2/domains/admin as admin returns 200 'The domain has been added successfully.'
Adding a domain the admin already exists as returns 400 'Domain already exists.'

requirements.statement: Abuse reporting is disabled without configuration: the report page requires REPORT_EMAIL and report submission requires mail to be enabled.

acceptanceCriteria.text: GET /report when REPORT_EMAIL is not set redirects to /
POST /api/v2/links/report returns 400 'Request is not allowed.' while MAIL_ENABLED is off

requirements.statement: The first-run /create-admin page shows an admin creation form and is only available before any account exists.

acceptanceCriteria.text: GET /create-admin shows the admin creation form when no user exists
GET /create-admin redirects to /login once any user exists

requirements.statement: The health endpoint responds OK without authentication.

acceptanceCriteria.text: GET /api/v2/health returns 200 with body 'OK'

requirements.statement: API requests can authenticate with an API key instead of a JWT.

acceptanceCriteria.text: GET /api/v2/links with the API key authenticates the request and returns the user's links
